{"id":195624,"tenderTitle":"54 MBAUD SOFTWARE DEFINED DEMODULATOR ON LOW-END PROCESSOR OR GRAPHICS PROCESSING UNIT (ARTES AT 7B.090) - RE-ISSUE","tenderNumber":"1-13394","tenderDescription":"Objective: The objective of the activity is to design, develop and test a 54 Mbaud DVB-S2 and 5G NR demodulator on a low-end Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) or Central Processing Unit (CPU).Targeted Improvements: Enabling a 54 Mbaud software defined radio for low end platforms not existing today in ESA Member States.Description: Previous projects have demonstrated that carriers of equivalent bandwidth can be demodulated in software on x86 server-level CPUs. Also, by using high-performance GPUs and parallel processing, bandwidths of hundreds of MHz or even many GHz could be demodulated.
